description: The Infrared Camera is AKARI's near- and mid-infrared focal-plane instrument, with three channels and nine imaging filters. ISAS posts relative spectral response tables for N2, N3, N4, S7, S9W, S11, L15, L18W, and L24, prepared from laboratory measurements of the optics with Martin Cohen.
facility_description: AKARI was Japan's second infrared astronomy satellite, with a 68.5 cm telescope cooled to 6 K, observing from 1.7 to 180 μm in a Sun-synchronous polar orbit until operations ended on 24 November 2011.
notes: The IRC RSRF page (last update 15 January 2007) defines FAD as Filter and Detector and says the curves include photon-to-energy conversion by multiplying by wavelength, so they can be integrated over F_λ spectra. Posted tables are n2.fad, n3.fad, n4.fad, s7.fad, s9w.fad, s11.fad, l15.fad, l18w.fad, and l24.fad. The older index http://www.ir.isas.jaxa.jp/AKARI/Observation/RSRF/IRC_FAD/index.html redirects to https and returns HTTP 404. Onaka et al. say the imaging throughput was estimated from laboratory measurements of each optic, then scaled by the in-flight absolute calibration (their Figure 7), and that N2 and N3 have small red leaks around 5 μm. Onaka et al. Table 1, as rendered on ar5iv, lists reference wavelengths N2 2.4, N3 3.2, N4 4.1, S7 7.0, S9W 9.0, S11 11.0, L15 15.0, L18W 18.0, and L24 24.0 μm, with the wavelength column defined as where the responsivity is larger than 1/e of the peak. Those table cells are split across lines in the HTML conversion, so they are not copied into per-band fields. The Murakami quotes keep the ar5iv \\micron escapes. The acknowledgement text includes the quotation marks printed inside the italic sentence on the publishing page. Licence quote is section 6 of the ISAS Data Policy. That section also says the rules are compatible with CC BY 4.0 and that third parties may impose other restrictions. The RSRF page credits Martin Cohen and the page footer says "Copyright © ISAS/JAXA. All Rights Reserved." The policy does not label these RSRF files as open data. Bibcodes are the ADS links on the ISAS citation list. Recorded licence class is permission because this footer is on the AKARI pages that were opened, and the ISAS Data Policy copy grant applies to data judged open. Those pages do not say the response curves are open data.

N2.Description: NIR imaging filter. Onaka et al. note color aberrations between N2 and the N3/N4 bands.

N3.Description: NIR imaging filter, grouped with N4 when Onaka et al. discuss color aberrations relative to N2.

N4.Description: NIR imaging filter, grouped with N3 when Onaka et al. discuss color aberrations relative to N2.

S9W.Description: Wide-band MIR-S filter used for the deep survey and the all-sky survey.

L18W.Description: Wide-band MIR-L filter used for the deep survey and the all-sky survey.
